title: Add Bold Tag In String
statement: You are given a string `s` and an array of distinct strings `words`. Wrap every substring of `s` that matches a word in `` and `` tags. Merge overlapping or adjacent matched ranges into one tagged range. Return the resulting string. ## Examples ```text Input: s = "abcxyz123", words = ["abc", "123"] Output: "abcxyz123" ``` ```text Input: s = "aaabbcc", words = ["aaa", "aab", "bc"] Output: "aaabbcc" ``` ```text Input: s = "abcdef", words = ["gh"] Output: "abcdef" ``` ## Constraints - `1 <= s.length <= 1000` - `0 <= words.length <= 100` - `1 <= words[i].length <= 1000` - `s` and each word contain only English letters and digits. - All strings in `words` are distinct.
